requirement:
Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
rationale:
I found no gaps. Every obligation in `requirements.definitions.inputs` has code that carries it out and a test that exercises it.

**Form: exactly `definition` and `text`.**
- `validate_input` (src/evidence.rs:762) routes any object with a `definition` key to `check_keys(["definition","text"])`. It reports any other field as an "unexpected field" error.
- `text_field` requires `text` to be a nonempty array of strings.
- Tests: `definition_schema_deletion_and_literal_references_are_checked` adds an unexpected field. `changed_definition_snapshots_show_a_compact_diff_and_text_is_required` removes `text`, sets it to `[]`, and sets it to a string.

**`definition` identifies one named definition.**
- `InputSelector::resolve`, Definition branch (src/inputs.rs:~250), looks the name up in the definitions map, keeps only `DefinitionKind::Term`, and otherwise returns "`<name>`: no matching named definition".

**`text` holds the complete raw fenced declaration, including the phrase option and body.**
- `to_input` (src/inputs.rs:182) records `resolved.text`, which is `target.raw_lines`.
- `definition_blocks` (src/lib.rs) strips option lines only when `kind != Term`. A term's `:phrase:` line therefore stays in `raw_lines`, as do the fence lines and the body.

**Reject missing definitions.**
- `validate_resolved_input` pushes an error carrying the label and the "no matching named definition" message.
- Test: `definition_schema_deletion_and_literal_references_are_checked` deletes `glossary.md` and asserts the error names `glossary.a`.

**Reject changed snapshot text, identify the definition, show a compact diff.**
- `validate_resolved_input` compares the recorded text with the current text and emits "input text changed for Definition { definition … }" followed by `compact_diff`. `compact_diff` strips the common prefix and suffix and caps the output at 8 lines per side.
- Tests: `changed_definition_snapshots_show_a_compact_diff_and_text_is_required` asserts the exact `-`/`+` lines. `cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review` changes the phrase and the body and expects "input text changed" with `glossary.`.

**Moving an unchanged definition does not invalidate its snapshot.**
- `raw_lines` holds only the declaration text. Line numbers live in the separate range and are not part of the compared text.
- Test: `cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review` prepends blank lines to `glossary.md`, which shifts every definition, and asserts there are no errors.

**Evidence displays show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.**
- `InputLocation::resolve` and `render_input` (src/index.rs) produce a summary labelled "definition `<name>`", the source location from `render_source_location`, and the recorded `text` in a code block.
- Test: `detail_page_shows_recorded_text_locations_and_first_matching_group` asserts the order of the definition name, the `md/rules.md:9–13` location, and the recorded text. It also covers the unresolved-selector case, which keeps the recorded text.
